name: olivia
description: Olivia MFSK decoder — the weak-signal keyboard-to-keyboard HF mode. Offers fldigi's eighteen tone/bandwidth combinations including the standard 8/250, 16/500 and 32/1000, with a live squelch, tune margin, integration depth and a lock/SNR readout. Decoding runs on the server; the panel is part of the V2 interface.
author: UberSDR

tones.description: Number of tones. Rounded down to a power of two. Eighteen tone/bandwidth combinations are offered, matching fldigi's quick-change list

bandwidth.description: Width of the tone block in Hz. Rounded down to a power-of-two multiple of 125

center_frequency.description: Audio frequency the tone block is centred on

sync_threshold.description: Squelch: the FEC signal-to-noise a block must reach before it is printed. Adjustable while decoding, without restarting the decoder

reverse.description: Decode an inverted tone block, for a signal received on the opposite sideband to the one it was sent on

contestia.description: Decode Contestia instead of Olivia (six-bit characters). No UI exposes this yet

sync_margin.description: fldigi's tune margin: how far either side of the centre the decoder searches, in FFT bins. Clamps automatically when the tone block sits too close to DC

sync_integ_len.description: fldigi's integration period, in FEC blocks. Deeper copies further into the noise but makes the wait before anything prints proportionally longer

eight_bit.description: Honour Olivia's escape for characters above 126 — a 127 means the next character plus 128. On by default, as fldigi has it
